interface.shortDescription: RCC automation skills with an optional, user-toggleable Dagger MCP server.
interface.longDescription: RCC v18.19.3 workflows split across focused skills for Environment Artifacts, providers, trust, coordination/prewarm, RCC core, robot projects, Robot Framework suites, RPA Framework automation, work items, Action Server packages, and CI maintenance. Includes an optional Dagger MCP server that users can enable or disable independently after installation.
defaultPrompt: Maintain RCC Robot Framework acceptance tests.
Publish and acquire a trusted RCC Environment Artifact.
Inspect an RCC artifact provider or prewarm workflow.
Build or debug an RCC automation with RPA Framework.
Use the bundled Dagger MCP server to inspect or run an RCC Dagger module.
